short_description: Qualifyze GmbH is a Frankfurt am Main-headquartered company founded in 2019 that operates an audit management and supplier-compliance data platform for the pharmaceutical and life-sciences industry. It runs GxP, ESG and ISO supplier audits through a global auditor network and turns the resulting audit data into a shared compliance and supplier-risk database used by drug manufacturers. Qualifyze raised a 54 million US dollar Series B round led by Insight Partners in September 2024.
